name: Peru
title: Calidad migratoria Inversionista (investor residence)
instrument: Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N° 1350, aprobado por Decreto Supremo N° 007-2017-IN, artículo 86.1 lit. a) and 86.3. Enabling statute: Decreto Legislativo N° 1350 (Decreto Legislativo de Migraciones), art. 29.2 lit. f.
source_title: MIGRACIONES: Ley y Reglamento (DL 1130, DL 1350, DS 007-2017-IN), Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones, 1st ed. June 2023
quote_original: Acreditar una inversión igual o superior de quinientos mil soles
quote_context: Artículo 86.- Calidad migratoria Inversionista / 86.1 ... a. Acreditar una inversión igual o superior de quinientos mil soles (S/ 500.000,00). El monto de inversión puede ser modificado mediante Resolución de Superintendencia. ... 86.3. El plazo de otorgamiento y de permanencia es de trescientos sesenta y cinco (365) días prorrogables.
corroborating_quote: Copia del documento que acredita una inversión igual o superior de
notes: PDF is an official Migraciones publication hosted on cdn.www.gob.pe; retrieved with curl + a browser User-Agent (plain WebFetch to www.gob.pe returns HTTP 418) and converted with `pdftotext -layout`. The quote_original is a single contiguous line in the extracted text; the amount in the PDF renders as 'quinientos mil soles (S/ 500.000,00)' with a European-style decimal separator, while the gob.pe trámite page at the corroborating_url renders it as 'S/ 500,000.00' on its own line with a double space after 'S/'. Cite the words, not the glyph spacing. The gob.pe corroborating page carries 'Último cambio 22 abril 2024' and still states S/ 500,000. NOTE: art. 86.1 lit. a expressly allows the amount to be changed by Resolución de Superintendencia; I searched for such a resolución and found none, but web-search budget ran out before I could exhaust the Migraciones 2025/2026 resolution collections at https://www.gob.pe/institucion/migraciones/colecciones/57344-resoluciones-de-la-superintendencia-2025 — that collection is the remaining place a revised figure could hide. Other verified conditions: investment must arrive by international transfer in a single disbursement through an SBS-supervised bank; shares transfers are expressly excluded (art. 86.2); holder may only act as Gerente or Director of the company; 365 days renewable. Separately, the newer 'Solicitar calidad migratoria de residente para inversionista' page (https://www.gob.pe/12879-..., Último cambio 23 enero 2026) has dropped the numeral and now says only 'el monto establecido en la normativa migratoria vigente' — worth watching.

name: Peru
title: Calidad migratoria Rentista (pension / permanent passive income)
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N° 1350, art. 29.2 lit. n (Rentista); Reglamento aprobado por Decreto Supremo N° 007-2017-IN, artículo 92. Monetary threshold is set by administrative act of MIGRACIONES, not by the Reglamento (art. 92.2).
source_title: Solicitar cambio de calidad migratoria rentista residente — Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones, gob.pe
quote_original: Copia del documento original del país de donde proviene la renta con un ingreso neto permanente no menor a
quote_context: Para el caso de renta de fuente extranjera: 'Copia del documento original del país de donde proviene la renta con un ingreso neto permanente no menor a US$ 1,000.00, legalizada por notario o autenticada por el fedatario de Migraciones.' Page also states: 'Esta calidad migratoria te otorga una permanencia indefinida en el Perú.'
corroborating_quote: acredite que el solicitante percibe un
notes: US$1,000.00 per month net permanent income from a foreign source — VERIFIED on two official gob.pe pages: 12933 (cambio de calidad migratoria, 'Último cambio 22 abril 2024') and 12875 (visa solicitation, 'Último cambio 17 junio 2024'). WHITESPACE WARNING: on both pages the amount is rendered as 'US$  1,000.00' with a DOUBLE space after 'US$' and sits on its own line in the extracted text, which is why quote_original stops just short of it — re-fetch and grep for '1,000.00' rather than string-matching the full sentence. Both pages fetched with curl + browser User-Agent; www.gob.pe returns HTTP 418 to WebFetch and Cloudflare browser-rendering returned 404. The Reglamento (DS 007-2017-IN art. 92.1/92.2/92.3) confirms the category and that 'El plazo de otorgamiento y de permanencia es indefinido' but deliberately does NOT fix the amount: 'El monto será establecido por acto administrativo de MIGRACIONES'. I did NOT locate the underlying acto administrativo itself, so the US$1,000 figure rests on the two official trámite pages rather than on a numbered instrument. For Peruvian-source income no numeric floor is published; the page asks only for proof of 'la renta mensual permanente'. A sworn declaration that the money enters Peru through an SBS-supervised bank is required.

name: Peru
title: Calidad migratoria Permanente (permanent residence after 3 years)
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N° 1350, art. 29.2 lit. m; Reglamento aprobado por Decreto Supremo N° 007-2017-IN, artículos 93 and 93-A. Three-year qualifying period (previously two) reflects the DL 1582 reform.
source_title: Solicitar cambio a calidad migratoria permanente residente — Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones, gob.pe
quote_original: Si eres un extranjero y has residido durante 3 años en el Perú de forma consecutiva, ya sea como trabajador, inversionista, investigador o perteneciente a alguna comunidad religiosa, puedes solicitar el cambio a la calidad migratoria permanente a través de la agencia digital de la
quote_context: Sentence continues '...Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones.' (link text). Reglamento art. 93.1: 'MIGRACIONES otorga esta calidad migratoria a las personas extranjeras que han residido durante tres (03) años en el Perú, de forma consecutiva.' Art. 93.2: 'Las personas con esta calidad migratoria tienen residencia indefinida en el Perú.'
corroborating_quote: extranjeras que han residido durante tres (03) años en el Perú, de forma
notes: Page carries 'Último cambio 27 noviembre 2024'. Feeder categories are trabajador, inversionista, investigador and religioso — the rentista category is NOT listed as a feeder, because rentista already confers indefinite permanence in its own right. Verified economic-solvency floor for the conversion: S/ 55,000.00 gross annual income for the prior fiscal year, applied to the trabajador, inversionista and investigador routes alike (rendered on the page as 'S/  55,000.00' with a double space, on its own line — grep for '55,000.00'). Investor applicants additionally must show payroll evidence of ten jobs held by Peruvians ('donde se pueda constatar la existencia de diez puestos de trabajo para peruanos') plus SUNAT tax compliance. Absence rule: applicant must not have been outside Peru for more than 183 consecutive calendar days within any 365-day window during the 3 years, unless holding an authorised stay-abroad permit (Reglamento art. 93-A lit. c). Carné de extranjería renews every 5 years (3 for minors). NOT VERIFIED: I did not confirm Peru's naturalisation residence period (Ley 26574) against a primary source in this pass; treat any counts-toward-naturalisation claim as unchecked.

name: Peru
title: Calidad migratoria Investigación / Investigador residente (researcher)
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N° 1350, art. 29.2 lit. g (Investigación); Reglamento aprobado por Decreto Supremo N° 007-2017-IN.
source_title: Solicitar visa de calidad migratoria investigación residente — Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones, gob.pe
quote_original: Este trámite te autoriza realizar cualquier actividad que genere ingresos dependiente o independiente en el sector público o privado.
quote_context: Opening paragraph: 'Si eres extranjero y posees conocimientos en los campos de ciencia, tecnología e innovación, así como en proyectos de educación de alta especialización; por intermedio de Concytec, puedes solicitar la calidad migratoria para investigación...'. DL 1350 art. 29.2 lit. g: 'Se extiende al extranjero que cuenta con conocimientos y experiencia reconocidos en los campos de la ciencia, la tecnología o la innovación... El plazo de permanencia es de hasta trescientos sesenta y cinco (365) días.'
corroborating_quote: Se extiende al extranjero que cuenta con conocimientos y experiencia reconocidos en los campos de la ciencia, la tecnología o la innovación; así como en proyectos de educación de alta especialización; por intermedio de la autoridad en ciencia y tecnología nacional.
notes: Page carries 'Último cambio 17 junio 2024'. This is Peru's closest analogue to a talent/skilled route and is distinct from the ordinary employer-sponsored 'trabajador' permit: eligibility is gated on CONCYTEC (Consejo Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación Tecnológica) certifying the applicant's researcher status, and the calidad authorises ANY income-generating activity, dependent or independent, public or private — it is not tied to a single employer. Requires a letter from a Peruvian public or private institution covering research activities for a period of one year or more. No investment or income threshold applies at initial grant; the S/ 55,000 gross annual income floor bites only at the later conversion to permanente. Applicant must be outside Peru when applying. Counts as a feeder to the permanente category (see peru-permanente). Applies with 365 days permanence, renewable.

name: Peru
title: Calidad migratoria Nómada Digital (enacted 2023, not yet grantable)
instrument: Decreto Legislativo N° 1582, which inserted lit. i 'Nómada digital' into art. 29.2 (Residencia) of Decreto Legislativo N° 1350. Published in El Peruano 14 November 2023; in force 15 November 2023.
source_title: Decreto Legislativo que modifica el Decreto Legislativo Nº 1350, Decreto Legislativo de Migraciones — DECRETO LEGISLATIVO N° 1582 — Diario Oficial El Peruano
quote_original: Permite a la persona extranjera ejercer una actividad laboral de forma subordinada, a través del uso de medios y sistemas informáticos, telemáticos o de telecomunicación o mecanismo análogo, cuya relación laboral debe generarse en el extranjero con una empresa domiciliada fuera del territorio nacional.
quote_context: Appears under '29.2. Residencia:' as 'i. Nómada digital.' Immediately following text: 'No comprende la realización de actividades remuneradas o lucrativas en territorio nacional que implique ingresos de fuente peruana. Es otorgada por MIGRACIONES. Las condiciones son fijadas en el Reglamento del presente Decreto Legislativo. El plazo de permanencia es de hasta trescientos sesenta y cinco (365) días. El plazo es prorrogable.'
corroborating_quote: La calidad migratoria nómada digital empezará a otorgarse una vez que se publique la resolución que reglamente éste y otros cambios realizados a la Ley de Migraciones, y se establezca el procedimiento correspondiente en el Texto Único de Procedimientos Administrativos de la entidad.
notes: IMPORTANT — this is law on the books but NOT a live route, and must never be presented as available. Two independent official signals: (1) the statute itself defers all conditions to the Reglamento ('Las condiciones son fijadas en el Reglamento'), and no such reglamento provision has been located; (2) Migraciones' own press note (corroborating_url, dated 20 November 2023) states the calidad will only begin to be granted once the implementing resolución is published and the procedure is added to the TUPA. Independently checked on 2026-07-30: the official Migraciones trámites index at https://www.gob.pe/institucion/migraciones/tramites lists every residence calidad (rentista, inversionista, investigación, trabajador, religioso, formación, designado, familiar) and contains NO nómada digital entry — that absence is the current evidence of non-availability. Note the classification detail most secondary write-ups get wrong: DL 1582 places nómada digital under art. 29.2 RESIDENCIA, not among the temporal calidades of 29.1. NOT VERIFIED: I could not find a 2025- or 2026-dated official statement restating the pending status; the non-availability finding rests on the 2023 press note plus the present-day absence from the trámites index. Next step if revisited: check DS 011-2024-IN (https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/dispositivo/NL/2337115-1, titled '...y aprueba nuevas calidades migratorias' — WebFetch returned 404 on that URL for me, so it needs a curl fetch) and DS 008-2025-IN for an implementing article.

name: Nicaragua
title: Residente Pensionado (Ley 694 retiree residence)
instrument: Ley N°. 694, Ley de Promoción de Ingreso de Residentes Pensionados y Residentes Rentistas. Approved 18/06/2009, published La Gaceta, Diario Oficial N°. 151 of 12/08/2009. Threshold REFORMED by Ley N°. 987, Ley de Reformas y Adiciones a la Ley N°. 822, Ley de Concertación Tributaria, published La Gaceta, Diario Oficial N°. 41 of 28 February 2019 (art. Tercero numeral IV). Digesto records the norm's status as 'Consolidada'.
source_title: Ley N°. 694, Ley de Promoción de Ingreso de Residentes Pensionados y Residentes Rentistas — Digesto Jurídico Nicaragüense, Asamblea Nacional
quote_original: equivalente en moneda nacional a la cantidad de Un Mil Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América (US$1,000.00) mensuales como mínimo y que deseen residir permanentemente en Nicaragua.
quote_context: Artículo 2, definition of RESIDENTE PENSIONADO: 'Persona natural nacional o extranjera que goza de una pensión o jubilación de gobiernos, instituciones públicas o privadas, equivalente en moneda nacional a la cantidad de Un Mil Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América (US$1,000.00) mensuales como mínimo y que deseen residir permanentemente en Nicaragua.' Restated at art. 4 numeral 1: 'La persona aplicante para obtener la condición de Residente Pensionado debe demostrar que recibe en el extranjero de forma estable y permanente, otorgada por gobiernos, instituciones públicas o privadas, una pensión mensual equivalente en moneda nacional a la cantidad de Un Mil Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América (US$1,000.00).' Each is followed in the consolidated text by the reform annotation naming Ley 987 and La Gaceta N°. 41 del 28 de febrero de 2019.
notes:
STALE-FIGURE CORRECTION: the widely-repeated US$600/month pensionado threshold is the pre-2019 figure and is WRONG. Ley 987 (La Gaceta N°. 41, 28 Feb 2019) raised it to US$1,000.00/month. Do not publish US$600.

RETRIEVAL CAVEAT — READ BEFORE RE-VERIFYING. digesto.asamblea.gob.ni is HTTP-ONLY in practice: https:// to that host hung and timed out at 25s and again at 90s (curl exit 000); plain http:// returns 200. The publisher being http-only is a property of the Nicaraguan government site, not a substitution on my part — no mirror or aggregator was used, and none should be. Additionally, the source_url page is a JavaScript shell: the statutory text is NOT in the HTML returned by a plain GET of that URL, so a naive re-fetch will find no quote. The text is served by an AJAX POST. Reproduce with:
  curl -sk --max-time 60 -A 'Mozilla/5.0' -H 'Referer: http://digesto.asamblea.gob.ni/consultas/normas/shownorms.php?idnorm=NzY0Nw==' --data 'hddQueryType=getNormaHtmlAccordion&iunp=NzY0Nw==&normaIunp=NzY0Nw==&idnorm=NzY0Nw==' 'http://digesto.asamblea.gob.ni/consultas/util/ws/proxy.php'
The response is an AkomaNtoso-namespaced XHTML fragment (~71 KB); strip tags before grepping, since the quoted sentence is broken by inline <span>/<b> markup in the raw payload. The Digesto record id is iunpid NzY0Nw== (base64 of 7647), found via the same proxy.php endpoint with hddQueryType=getJuridicNorms&txtNumNorm=694.

Other conditions verified in the same text: minimum age 45 (art. 10 numeral 3, 'Certificado de Nacimiento que demuestre que tiene una edad mínima de cuarenta y cinco años de edad'); certification must show capacity to pay the pension for at least five years (art. 10 numeral 2); the category extends to parents, spouse/partner, minor children and exceptionally relatives to the fourth degree, but each additional family member requires a further US$150.00/month (art. 5). Administering body VERIFIED as INTUR, not Migración: art. 8 requires the application to be filed with the Instituto Nicaragüense de Turismo or a Nicaraguan consulate abroad, INTUR approves and certifies the category on a Comité Técnico opinion, and then transmits it to the Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería. Art. 7 numeral 1 confers the right to 'Solicitar la residencia permanente de forma inmediata ante la Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería (DGME)' — hence outcome is permanent residence, not a temporary status. The consolidated text also shows the law was still being amended as recently as Ley 1121 (La Gaceta N°. 102, 6 June 2022), which is positive evidence the regime remains on the statute book.

NOT VERIFIED: whether INTUR is still processing applications in practice as of 2026. migob.gob.ni and www.migob.gob.ni both return HTTP 403 to curl, and www.asamblea.gob.ni returns 403; I did not reach a current INTUR requisitos page. Treat administrative availability as unconfirmed and confidence as medium on that point only — the legal text and the figure are solid.

name: Nicaragua
title: Residente Rentista (Ley 694 passive-income residence)
instrument: Ley N°. 694, Ley de Promoción de Ingreso de Residentes Pensionados y Residentes Rentistas, arts. 2 and 4 numeral 2. Approved 18/06/2009, published La Gaceta, Diario Oficial N°. 151 of 12/08/2009. Threshold REFORMED by Ley N°. 987, published La Gaceta, Diario Oficial N°. 41 of 28 February 2019.
source_title: Ley N°. 694, Ley de Promoción de Ingreso de Residentes Pensionados y Residentes Rentistas — Digesto Jurídico Nicaragüense, Asamblea Nacional
quote_original: renta estable permanente generada en el exterior por un monto mínimo mensual equivalente en moneda nacional a la cantidad de Un Mil Doscientos Cincuenta Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América (US$ 1,250.00) y que deseen residir permanentemente en Nicaragua.
quote_context: Artículo 2, definition of RESIDENTE RENTISTA: 'Persona natural nacional o extranjera que goza de una renta estable permanente generada en el exterior por un monto mínimo mensual equivalente en moneda nacional a la cantidad de Un Mil Doscientos Cincuenta Dólares de los Estados Unidos de América (US$ 1,250.00) y que deseen residir permanentemente en Nicaragua.' Art. 4 numeral 2 restates it for income 'generadas por distribución de utilidades, alquiler u otros negocios legales análogos'. Both carry the Ley 987 / La Gaceta N°. 41 del 28 de febrero de 2019 reform annotation.
notes:
STALE-FIGURE CORRECTION: the commonly cited US$750/month rentista threshold is the pre-2019 figure and is WRONG. Ley 987 (La Gaceta N°. 41, 28 Feb 2019) raised it to US$1,250.00/month. Do not publish US$750.

Note the punctuation differs between the two definitions in the consolidated text — the pensionado figure is written '(US$1,000.00)' with no space after 'US$', the rentista figure '(US$ 1,250.00)' WITH a space. Both are reproduced above exactly as they appear; do not normalise them.

Same retrieval caveat as the pensionado row: digesto.asamblea.gob.ni is HTTP-ONLY (https times out, curl exit 000 at both 25s and 90s), and the statutory text is not present in a plain GET of source_url — it is delivered by an AJAX POST to http://digesto.asamblea.gob.ni/consultas/util/ws/proxy.php with hddQueryType=getNormaHtmlAccordion and iunp=NzY0Nw==. This is the official Asamblea Nacional legislation portal; no mirror or aggregator was consulted or should be substituted.

Qualifying income must be generated ABROAD ('generada en el exterior') — this is what distinguishes rentista from a domestic-income route. Same shared conditions as pensionado: minimum age 45 (art. 10 numeral 3), proof of five years' sustainability (art. 10 numeral 2), +US$150.00/month per additional dependent family member (art. 5), filed with INTUR or a Nicaraguan consulate (art. 8), and art. 7 numeral 1 grants immediate application for residencia permanente before the DGME. Fiscal benefits under art. 7 also verified: duty-free household goods up to US$20,000; IVA exemption on one vehicle with CIF value up to US$13,000 (reduced from US$25,000 by Ley 987, art. 288 numeral 10), renewable every four years; one-time IVA exemption on construction materials up to US$50,000 for an owner-occupied home.

NOT VERIFIED: current administrative availability — migob.gob.ni returns HTTP 403 and I reached no live INTUR requisitos page.

name: Nicaragua
title: Investor / other residence categories under Ley 761, Ley General de Migración y Extranjería

source_title: Ley N°. 761, Ley General de Migración y Extranjería — Digesto Jurídico Nicaragüense, Asamblea Nacional
quote_original: Ley General de Migración y Extranjería
quote_context: Returned by the Digesto search index as: iunpid MTI4NDQ= | Ley 761 | registro 'Consolidada' | 'La Gaceta, Diario Oficial N°. 126 del 07/07/2011' | titulo 'Ley General de Migración y Extranjería'.
notes:
HOW FAR I GOT: I located the authoritative Digesto record for Ley 761 and confirmed its identity, gazette citation (La Gaceta N°. 126, 07/07/2011) and its 'Consolidada' (in-force, consolidated) status via the Digesto search API. The only text I can vouch for character-for-character is the title, which is why quote_original is just that — I had NOT yet pulled the article text when work stopped, so I can state nothing about whether Ley 761 contains an investor residence category, nor any threshold. NEXT STEP (single command, endpoint already proven to work on Ley 694):
  curl -sk --max-time 60 -A 'Mozilla/5.0' -H 'Referer: http://digesto.asamblea.gob.ni/consultas/normas/shownorms.php?idnorm=MTI4NDQ=' --data 'hddQueryType=getNormaHtmlAccordion&iunp=MTI4NDQ=&normaIunp=MTI4NDQ=&idnorm=MTI4NDQ=' 'http://digesto.asamblea.gob.ni/consultas/util/ws/proxy.php'
Then strip tags and grep for 'inversionista', 'residencia temporal', 'residencia permanente', and 'Artículo 4'. PUBLISHER CAVEAT: digesto.asamblea.gob.ni serves over HTTP ONLY — https:// hangs and times out (curl exit 000 at 25s and at 90s). legislacion.asamblea.gob.ni likewise times out over https but http://legislacion.asamblea.gob.ni/normaweb.nsf returns 200. migob.gob.ni, www.migob.gob.ni and www.asamblea.gob.ni all return HTTP 403 to curl. https://www.lagaceta.gob.ni/ returns 200 and is untried. State the http-only limitation plainly rather than substituting a mirror; aggregators are not citable here.

ALSO UNFINISHED, same next-step method: (a) Decreto N°. 31-2012, Reglamento de la Ley 761; (b) Ley N°. 344 Ley de Promoción de Inversiones Extranjeras and Ley N°. 917 Ley de Inversión Extranjera — whether either confers residence rights; (c) any Nicaraguan remote-worker/digital-nomad category — I ran no successful check on this at all and reached no conclusion either way, so nothing about it should be recorded as a finding.

A background research agent was dispatched to cover exactly these items and it terminated on an upstream API error before returning anything, so none of its work is available.
